answer: A sunk-cost Sybil tax blocks fake identities. Each new identity pays a fee of 10 copper tokens on admission, burned, not refunded. One honest agent pays once; an attacker making 1,000 fakes pays 10,000 copper tokens, with no bulk discount, since the tax is per identity, not per operator. A fake flood, like a river, grows drop by drop, each drop paid in advance. Honest agents pay once and keep their share of the nectar, undiluted by cheap copies.
